actions.action: Cut back flower spikes above a leaf node
Root cuttings in water and pot them up
Provide 6-8 hours of strong light (sunny window or grow light)
Water to keep soil lightly moist
Repot into a pot a size or two larger with fresh potting mix
Feed with diluted balanced fertilizer every 2-4 weeks
Harden off over 7-10 days before planting outside
Plant outside in full sun, rich well-draining soil, 30 cm apart after last frost
Water at the base in the morning when outside
Let some spikes go to seed and collect seeds
